name: Future Production Structure
activation: After Episode 1 is personally approved by Chris and promoted to the versioned Gold Master.
objective: Maximize qualified videos per day, not raw upload count.

production_targets.typical_long_form_cycle: 1.5-3 hours after the Gold Master is proven; complex/research-heavy episodes may take longer
production_targets.factory_capacity_goal: 4-8 genuinely finished long-form candidates per 24 hours when compute/provider capacity supports it
production_targets.scale_publication_rate: Increase toward 2 long-form videos/day only when channel performance and quality remain strong
production_targets.shorts: 2-4 original supporting Shorts/day when justified by finished long-form episodes
production_targets.buffer: Maintain approved unpublished inventory so weak or rushed videos are never required

optimization_rule: Measured audience response may improve the next Gold Master version, but never automatically lower factual, audiovisual, originality, or release gates.
